collection.title: Toy models of modular forms over finite fields
collection.authors: Author, E. A.; Author, E. B.
collection.abstract: We study toy models of modular forms over finite fields. Nothing here is a real result.

collection.title: A synthetic note on supersingular isogeny graphs
collection.abstract: This synthetic abstract describes isogeny graphs of supersingular curves. It exists only as test data.

collection.title: Fictional bounds for twisted exponential sums
collection.abstract: We prove fictional bounds for twisted exponential sums with multiplicative coefficients and discuss an invented application to modular forms.
